title: Q4 Alignment Sprint: Hosted API Catalog & Model Retirement Playbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Objective: Run a focused alignment sprint to finalize Q4 roadmap lanes that bind hosted API endpoint commitments to model catalog decisions (onboarding, rotation, and retirement). This ticket produces an executable playbook: lane assignments, gating criteria, OKR mapping, and communication cadence for internal stakeholders and customers.

Scope:
- Define cohort windows for model retirement and replacement (low-risk, medium-risk, high-risk endpoints).
- Map each hosted endpoint to a canonical model lineage tag and retention policy.
- Set canary windows and capacity hedges for model swaps.
- Produce an OKR/initiative mapping that ties roadmap commits to product and infra metrics (latency, p99, cost/unit, model-quality delta).

Success metrics:
- 90% of hosted API endpoints have a model lineage tag and retirement window assigned by due date.
- Roadmap lanes include clear rollback triggers and canary durations for 100% of tiered endpoints.
- Stakeholder sign-off from Eng, Design, and Security for the playbook and communications plan.

Trade-offs considered:
- Aggressive retirement reduces maintenance cost but increases customer migration risk. We'll prioritize cohorting by telemetry (usage and error rates) instead of calendar-only retirement.
- Longer canaries improve safety at cost of slower rollout; default will be 72h for medium-risk and 7d for high-risk endpoints, adjustable per endpoint via an exception process.

Approach:
- 2-week alignment sprint with weekly stakeholder workshops and daily PM standups.
- Work with Eng to run lightweight stress simulations on candidate replacement models to validate throughput and latency delta.
- Collaborate with Console team to expose a temporary "roadmap lane" view for stakeholders to validate assignments.
